description: Markdown Auto-Tests for .net 8+ and TUnit: write your test cases in markdown files. This package brings MDAT.TUnit and MDAT.Core.
releaseNotes: mdAT 2.0 replaces MSTest by TUnit and ships as MDAT.Core (framework independent) and MDAT.TUnit. See the migration section of the README. Projects staying on MSTest can keep using 1.x. Beta 2: a JsonDocument or JsonElement whose root is a string holding a JSON object or array is written as that object or array again (mdAT 1.4 behaviour); parallelism and code coverage notes added to the migration guide. Beta 3: the test explorer now points each case to its title in the markdown file (or to the start of its document in a YAML file) instead of the C# method. Beta 4: a test case is named Method_Title@file.md (file name last, no path); the title of the raw output written by Verify.Assert shows readable type names (for example List of JsonNode instead of the compiler name). Beta 5: each markdown test file keeps a link to its C# test, inserted or corrected when the line of the test changes and never written again when nothing changed; the name of a case no longer repeats the name of the method; fixes for a markdown file shared by several tests. Beta 6: a case marked skipped in a markdown file is now listed and reported as ignored by the test explorer (the reason is in French on a French computer) instead of being left out of the list. Beta 7: when a case is marked selected, the other cases of the file stay in the list, ignored, instead of being hidden; a case can have categories and properties (category=Smoke,Fast priority=High in the line of its code block, tags: in the front matter of the file), kept by ignored cases too; the file of generateExpectedData is written again when another process is using it.
